newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Hong Kong stocks expected to ease on profit-taking.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong stocks expected to ease on profit-taking.

text.p: Hong Kong stocks are expected to open easier on Thursday with some profit-taking expected after a surge in the Hang Seng Index on Wednesday, brokers said.

The Hang Seng Index jumped 302.88 points, or 2.40 percent, to close at 12,903.30 on Wednesday, but the Hang Seng London Reference index of Hong Kong stocks in London later eased 90.01 points, or 0.70 percent, to 12,813.29.
"After yesterday's market surge, trading is expected to move sideways with some profit-taking," said Antony Mak, sales director at Vickers Ballas.
